title: Correct final answer (1)
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (1) must be 0.94 s (or equivalent with correct rounding to 2 significant figures).

title: Correct final answer (2)
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (2) must be 0.98 s (or equivalent with correct rounding to 2 significant figures).

title: Applies Doppler formula
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the Doppler effect formula for time intervals, Δt' = ((v_P - v_S) / (v_P - v_A)) * Δt, or derive it from wavefront spacing arguments.

title: Identifies relative motion signs
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly assign signs to source and observer velocities relative to the direction of sound propagation (e.g., positive for motion toward the other).

title: Shows substitution and calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must clearly substitute the given numerical values (v_P=340 m/s, v_S, v_A, Δt=1.0 s) into the correct formula.

title: Proper rounding
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers are explicitly rounded to two significant figures as requested.

title: Sign error in velocity
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign convention for velocities (e.g., treating motion toward as negative), leading to an incorrect ratio.

title: Misapplies stationary formula
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if for part (2) the student incorrectly uses the formula for a stationary observer (i.e., neglects v_A).
